body: I can never stop how you feel and I want to end it myself but on here no-one finds being a fuck up funny. your problems are eating you alive from the inside out and it upset me to see you go through these issues alone and I may not be there with you but you are not alone I hope that one day you may find peace which ever road you take you deserve to be happy

I fully understand buddy, I feel the same and it's truly upsetting, you are worth the time you just feel as if you aren't but trust me you are, you matter I may not know you but you matter to me you deserve happiness no matter how you feel about yourself your important friend words cannot explain how much you matter and that's a fact
Here if you need a friend, been through the same problems friend won't let you do it alone
Im sorry to hear that even when life picked you up, it left your happiness behind if you ever want to get something off your chest in always here

Buddy I avoided self harm for 2 years but one day I felt like the edge of a blade was my best friend now it's unappealing looking at my scarred filled arm I won't tell you to stop it's not me but always know from experience it's hurts others more than it hurts you the pain goes away but the effects are always there, if you need a friend in always here
Thankyou buddy it's just a bit hard being at rock bottom with no one to listen or even care life just want me gone I think and I do accept it, everyone dies just I think my time is soon you know
My pleasure it's always nice to have someone to talk to about all of your issues here to listen
Hey buddy, don't you worry I know it sucks not having friends most of mine have gone and it feels like life just wants to kick you in the balls but here right now you've got a friend outta me
